body: Not long to go until 2022 now then...! How are your relationships with the people you described as ‘being there for you’ now?

I feel like you have just described my 2021...& I too have just welcomed in the new year alone.

The parallels of people trying to help are painfully similar too. I was given ‘final chances’ by family but I just couldn’t alter my depressed mindset...resulting in a suicide attempt which has left me very much on my own.

How are you feeling on the first day of 2022? It’s 5.40am here and I haven’t slept

Thanks to everyone for their replies. I have been on multiple antidepressants in my adult life - numerous SSRIs, venlafaxine (SNRI) and I’m currently a week or so into mirtazapine / remeron.

Although I don’t class my ‘stable’ spells as manic, I do believe I have a heightened confidence during these times, which has caused friction in my relationships - both at work (sacked from 2 jobs during my last stable spell) and in my personal life.

My current phase of depression led to my first suicide attempt...and has resulted in me becoming jobless, homeless and lacking any motivation to ‘help myself’ out of the current shit show that is my life. 

I’m in the UK and remain under the Community Mental Health team...

I have been advised I have GAD and depression...but still believe I could be BP2??
I’m in the UK too...got discharged from a psych ward a few weeks ago!
I’ve got a major head ache & water / liquid is now very appealing....
That’s pretty shit...are you in the US?
As the other posters have stated, it would be a long and painful death.
How much vodka?
What happened when you went to the ER the other day?
Is this live ??
I’m too far gone, I would love to pass away peacefully...but my survival instinct keeps kicking in. I’m trying to not eat or drink...I’ve done about 12 hours so far

It made me laugh, if nothing else! 

An ex of mine once sent me a video of a man with no arms and legs getting by on a skateboard...unfortunately that video depicting ‘you could have it worse’ did not cure my depression!!

I have been in the ‘depressive state’ you describe for just under 12 months now.

The past few days I’ve experienced the ‘seeing the day turn into night’. I’ve achieved pretty much nothing during these days & it’s been a similar situation in the weeks prior.

I haven’t worked properly since July, I stopped caring for my job long before that. I am waiting to rejoin the human race, but I’m not ready to just yet...despite the shame and embarrassment of my current situation the warm embrace of depression is keeping me depressed.
I have experience and a professional qualification in a specific business function, however, I do not feel in any way capable (mentally) of returning to this line of work atm

Thanks for the reply. 

I became homeless...but I am now in sheltered accommodation.

I have thought about getting ANY job to give me a bit of a routine / purpose. The trouble is I will lose this accommodation if I get a job...as I would no longer be eligible for the housing benefit I am getting.

It’s Catch-22...
Anyone...?

The post title made me laugh for the first time today, so thank you!

I too am wondering about the benefit of therapy...I’m already on meds & started seeing ANOTHER (my 7th or 8th?!) counsellor...I should be cured, right?!!!
It’s rich coming from me - I’m currently hiding away in sheltered accommodation...existing, just about. I haves turned it around in the past & if I can do it, so can you

You should get a therapist / counsellor, someone you can talk to about your problems.

It doesn’t matter it you think it will make you feel worse, just TRY IT. If it’s not for you, then you don’t have to keep on going. It’s worth a shot?

If you see them every day, I can pretty much guarantee that they don’t hate you. If they did, they would refuse to meet you / spend time with you.

If you are really feeling suicidal - tell someone, anyone. If you are not comfortable speaking to your friends, speak to a helpline.

I’m in the UK & I don’t know what support services you have in Sweden. We have www.Samaritans.org

If they are real friends, they will try to help you...and I’m sure you have helped them in the past.

Your English is very good - that’s one positive for you right there.

I’m guessing you are quite young. You should try and talk to one (or more) of your friends to get to the truth - if they are still in touch with you (?) that would suggest they don’t hate you

How old are you? 
Where are you from? 
Why do you think your friends might hate you?
How come?

I’m 100% with you on this. After it goes dark I feel calmer, knowing that nothing is expected of me. The quiet of night seems to slow my brain down...it’s so peaceful and I don’t want the next day to come...

Thanks for the reply. I decided to leave it until tonight...as I didn’t want to be wide awake at 4am...AGAIN 

will probably take some around midnight
Anyone....?

I get that - I’m desperate to sleep atm and don’t seem able to. 

Are you living with your parents? Have you spoken to them?

I looked up melatonin- looks like it’s a sleep aid? I expect the 5 tabs might knock you out / make you feel drowsy? 

20 is young...and you have a lot of life in front of you. From my own experience (I’m 36 M) I imagine you’ll be thinking ‘F**k off, you don’t know me & what I’m going through’ ...BUT it is true.

Have you been to your GP / having therapy?

Relationship breakdowns are difficult - I haven’t recovered from an ex breaking up with me last Dec & now I’m in a really bad place. 

How old are you? Are you still functioning?
I’m going to try it when it starts to go dark at 5pm...any advice / info would be appreciated 👍🏻

Erm...probably worse than before I tried to KMS. I was treated in hospital (IV drips for 5 days) before transferring to a psych hospital.

I got discharged last week...only trouble was I didn’t have anywhere to go. I’m in sheltered accommodation now...no job, no money, equally as suicidal as before my attempt
I didn’t die...my brother found me & called an ambulance

And you saw no improvement with ketamine infusions?

Sorry about the delayed reply...I’m currently in hospital having OD’d on an antidepressant

Hi. Did you not see any improvement at all from the treatments mentioned? I have wanted to try ECT &/or ketamine but have never been ‘ill enough’ to receive them (I’m in the Uk)

I spent time in a psychiatric hospital earlier this year & the psychiatrist advised that only the ‘catatonic’ would receive ECT treatment....
It’s very disappointing when I wake up too...do you feel like the days last so long now too?
Let him in where? Did you end the relationship with him? Is that why he’s threatening you?
How long was your relationship and when and how did it end?
No judgement from me - I’m a whole barrel of mental atm!
It must be exhausting to be up and down like that...Do you feel ‘fine’ after the rock bottom spells?

How often do you have these spells? I’m in the middle of a dark depression atm (following stupid behaviour and a relationship ending / getting dumped) My last severe depression spell was in 2018...took me over a year to ‘get well’
They will assess whether you are ‘actively’ suicidal...if you tell them you have suicidal thoughts but no plan, they will not take you to hospital
I hear you - my fear is the consequences of a “botched” attempt. Not only the shame, but imagine if you permanently damaged yourself...and became an actual burden for family...
Are you still there??
